name: agenticos
description: Open-source, self-hosted AI agent platform for your company's AI teammates. Build, run and govern agents on your own servers and models: shared chat, RAG, skills, a real browser, 4,700+ MCP servers, budgets, approvals and an audit trail. An alternative to ChatGPT Enterprise and Grok Bot. Apache-2.0, built on Pydantic AI.

analysis.summary_en: Build, run and govern agents on your own servers and models: shared chat, RAG, skills, a real browser, MCP, budgets, approvals and an audit trail.
highlights: Files, code and output: calculations in Python, a sandbox with files and a shell, a coding agent that hands work to Claude Code or Codex, charts, drawings (diagrams, calculators, 3D scenes)…
HIPAA profile: deploy/profiles/hipaa/ and agenticos cmd doctor --profile hipaa check a running deployment against the §164.312 technical safeguards.
Through your cloud contract: Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.
Sandboxes: the API holds no Docker socket; containers get no network unless needed, with CPU, process and time limits; gVisor optional.
